body.x: Wagan(http://www.wagan.com) is a leading developer and manufacturer of high-tech electronics such as power inverters, solar power generators, portable power supplies, and other consumer electronics. Wagan offers one of the broadest lines of inverters in the industry, ranging from 80 watts to 10,000 watts.

The company’s goal is to supply consumers with power for their every need – whether for mobile electronics, small appliances, or even home necessities. Today, Wagan continues to expand on this goal with innovations in providing consumers renewable power that is portable through solar power generators.
With headquarters in California, Wagan strives to meet the needs of customers both domestically and internationally through its innovative products.
Wagan will exhibit their products at 2012 International CES, booth 30269 LVCC South Hall 3, Jan 10 - 13, 2012, in Las Vegas NV, US.
